Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class ResearchController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.ResearchController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/research") public class ResearchController extends Object
REST controller that exposes the research pipeline via POST /api/v1/research.

Validates and maps the incoming ResearchRequestDto to a domain ResearchRequest, delegates to ConductResearchUseCase, and maps the resulting ResearchAnswer back to a ResearchAnswerDto for the response.

When the optional X-Subscriber-Email header is present, the controller checks the subscriber's monthly AI query usage against their tier limit. If the limit is reached, HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) is returned with usage details. Without the header, requests are allowed anonymously (backwards-compatible).

Validation rules applied here:

  • query must be non-blank; returns HTTP 400 otherwise.
  • mode defaults to LEGACY_GOOGLE when absent or unrecognised.
  • maxSources defaults to 20 when absent; clamped to [1, 100].
